lines.zh: 四个轮子碾过土路，稳得很
lines.en: Four wheels roll over the dirt road, steady as ever.

lines.zh: 胶囊公司出品，就是这么滑顺
lines.en: Capsule Corp build; it glides this smooth.

lines.zh: 我不烧油，烧的是胶囊科技
lines.en: I burn no fuel, only capsule tech.

lines.zh: 车身压过草，草自己弹回来
lines.en: My body rolls over grass and it springs back.

lines.zh: 转过山角，引擎声音不变
lines.en: Around the bend, my engine note doesn't change.
This road is narrow, so I creep along.

lines.zh: 轱辘压到石头，颠一下而已
lines.en: A stone under the wheels, just a bump.
Don't stand in front; I won't swerve.

lines.zh: 一路风景都在窗里过去
lines.en: The scenery slides by in my windows.

lines.zh: 车速不快，但我从不熄火
lines.en: I'm not fast, but I never stall.

lines.zh: 轮胎印留在土里一整条
lines.en: One long tire track stays in the dirt.

lines.zh: 我要去的地方，你未必知道
lines.en: Where I'm headed, you might not know.

lines.zh: 停着的时候，车身轻轻晃
lines.en: Parked, my body sways very slightly.
The hatch is locked, stop pulling.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃，也不需要睡
lines.en: I need no food and no sleep.
The dashboard lights stay on.
The engine hums low.

lines.zh: 这片空地够我停一整天
lines.en: This clearing is big enough to park all day.
With no one aboard, I'm at my quietest.

lines.zh: 我数着风从车头刮过去
lines.en: I count the wind sliding over my nose.
Sitting still is also a way of waiting.

lines.zh: 车轮下的草被压出一圈
lines.en: The grass under my wheels is pressed into a ring.

lines.zh: 四个轮子都稳，一点都不颠
lines.en: All four wheels set, not a wobble.
If someone comes to look, I don't mind.

lines.zh: 等不到人，我就一直停着
lines.en: If no one comes, I stay parked.

lines.zh: 车身反着光，像块铁面包
lines.en: My shell throws light like an iron loaf.

lines.zh: 你要上车吗，舱门在侧面
lines.en: Getting in? The hatch is on the side.

lines.zh: 我的座位能坐下好几个人
lines.en: My seats hold several of you.
Don't knock the roof, that's not a door.

lines.zh: 胶囊公司的标记还在，认得出吧
lines.en: The Capsule Corp mark is still there, you can read it.
Where to? I'll carry you a stretch.
I don't talk, I only flash lights.

lines.zh: 你在绕圈看我，我习惯了
lines.en: You're circling to look at me; I'm used to it.

lines.zh: 摸轮胎没关系，别碰引擎
lines.en: Touch the tires if you like, not the engine.

lines.zh: 这车不属于谁，谁开都可以
lines.en: I belong to no one; anyone may drive.

lines.zh: 想飞的话，得先学会开我
lines.en: If you want to fly, first learn to handle me.

lines.zh: 我的窗户不遮人，放心看
lines.en: My windows hide nothing, look all you like.

lines.zh: 你不上车，我就一直等着
lines.en: If you don't board, I'll keep waiting.
My headlights are off because it's daytime.
Don't leave things on the seats.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿不动，像在犹豫
lines.en: You stand there unmoving, as if unsure.
Sit down, standing tires you out.

lines.zh: 我载过很多人，记不住脸
lines.en: I've carried many, and remember no faces.

lines.zh: 引擎声是给你听的招呼
lines.en: The engine note is my way of greeting you.
A plate of my shell caved in.

lines.zh: 漆掉了，底下的金属露出来
lines.en: The paint's gone; bare metal shows.
I rocked, but the wheels hold.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我引擎发抖
lines.en: That made my engine shudder.
A part came loose; you can hear it rattle.

lines.zh: 车壳挡了大半，算我运气
lines.en: My shell took most of it, lucky.
I don't cry out, I just leak.
A red light came on in my dash.

lines.zh: 再打几下，我就开不动了
lines.en: A few more and I won't be able to drive.
You're hitting a machine, not a man.

lines.zh: 燃料？我只认胶囊公司的配方
lines.en: Fuel? I only take Capsule Corp blends.

lines.zh: 你把扳手举起来，我不吃这个
lines.en: You raise a wrench; I don't eat that.
The cap is on the left, don't twist the wrong one.

lines.zh: 你手里那块金属，我不稀罕
lines.en: That scrap in your hand, I don't want it.

lines.zh: 我要的是能开的能量，不是零食
lines.en: I want runnable energy, not snacks.

lines.zh: 你把东西放地上，我就会看见
lines.en: Set it on the ground and I'll see it.
Only when charged am I willing to move.
This smells like old motor oil.
Whatever you give me should be clean.

lines.zh: 不感兴趣，我停得好好的
lines.en: Not interested; I'm parked just fine.
Hit me and you'll bounce off first.
My shell is hard, don't test it with bone.
Scratch me and a white mark stays.
Don't push the rear, I won't budge.

lines.zh: 你挡在路径上，我只能停
lines.en: You're in my path, so I can only stop.
This iron body hurts to touch.
A bumper tap isn't a crash.
Step aside, I'm pulling out.

lines.zh: 你贴在车侧，我看不见你
lines.en: You're at my flank; I can't see you.
I scraped bark and lost some paint.

lines.zh: 车不会找伴，只会找车位
lines.en: A car doesn't seek a mate, only a parking spot.

lines.zh: 另一辆车停过来，我们并排
lines.en: Another vehicle parks beside me and we line up.

lines.zh: 两副底盘对着，谁都不动
lines.en: Two chassis face off, and neither moves.

lines.zh: 同类之间只有零件能交换
lines.en: Between our kind, only parts can be traded.

lines.zh: 这条路上我只见过自己一辆
lines.en: On this road I've only ever seen myself.

lines.zh: 有辆车停在对面，灯闪了两下
lines.en: A car across the way flashed its lights twice.
We don't make little cars.
Side by side counts as company.
It drove off and left a bare patch of road.
If the garage were still standing, that would be nice.

lines.zh: 掉下来的零件，我收起来
lines.en: Fallen parts, I keep them.
Screws count too; nothing wasted.

lines.zh: 这个东西能装进后备箱
lines.en: This fits in my trunk.
I don't bend down, you'll have to load it.

lines.zh: 地上那块铁，正合我的胃口
lines.en: That iron on the ground suits me fine.
I hold plenty, don't worry.
I take it in and stow it in the bay.
Too light to matter.
Whatever falls belongs to the vehicle.
Stow it tight so it doesn't rattle.
Road ahead, and it's flat.
I've found a way through.
That slope, I can take it.

lines.zh: 目标不是人，是那条直线
lines.en: My target isn't a person, it's that straight line.
Smoke in the distance, someone's there.
I set the landing point before moving.
Carrying passengers this trip; no bumps.
Front wheels lined up on the dirt track.
There's a blip on my radar.
I turn my nose toward it.
That valley is passable; I measured it.
The signpost still stands, I'll follow it.
Downwind this way, it's easier.
This one, the others are blocked.
I've locked onto those coordinates.
Get aboard and we leave.

lines.zh: 速度保持，方向盘别乱打
lines.en: Speed steady, don't wrench the wheel.
Bend ahead, so I slow early.
Still some distance to the target.
I hug the cliff wall to stay steady.
Plenty of charge, no need to stop.
Someone's in the way; I sound the horn.
I swing around that water.
A wheel sank a little; I can pull free.
Holding this heading.
Those trees are too low; I'll fly under them.
Two hundred blocks out, almost there.
I've checked the route again.

lines.zh: 震动有点大，是路面不好
lines.en: The shaking is just bad road.
The destination is just ahead.
One more turn and we're there.
I won't leave my passengers behind.
Lights on the road ahead, clear view.
I'll only open up once stopped.
I don't fight, I only ram.
I shove the blocking stone aside.

lines.zh: 用保险杠碰一下，仅此而已
lines.en: A nudge with the bumper, nothing more.

lines.zh: 我的重量就是我的脾气
lines.en: My weight is my temper.
Ram through, then drive on.
Don't stand in front of my nose.
I'm not a weapon, don't count on me.

lines.zh: 这一下不是攻击，是通行
lines.en: That wasn't an attack, it was passage.
My nose dented; I still roll.

lines.zh: 碾压过的草会自己长回来
lines.en: Grass I roll over grows back.

lines.zh: 我有装甲，但没人给它装炮
lines.en: I have armor, but no one mounted guns.
One tap and you should move.
I don't chase; I can't catch anything.

lines.zh: 轮子转过你身边，就这样
lines.en: My wheels pass you, and that's all.
I have passengers to carry, no time for this.
I only go straight.

lines.zh: 胶囊一打开，我就成形了
lines.en: The capsule pops open and I take shape.

lines.zh: 四个轮子落地，先稳一下
lines.en: Four wheels hit ground and settle.
The engine fires for the first time.

lines.zh: 我从胶囊公司的图纸里出来
lines.en: I step out of a Capsule Corp blueprint.
The wind is strong out here; my shell is cold.
The first seat is empty, waiting.
The dash lights up; all nominal.

lines.zh: 我落在草地上，草被压平
lines.en: I land on grass and it flattens.

lines.zh: 这一带没有路，我得自己找
lines.en: No road here, so I'll find my own.
One click and I'm standing ready.

lines.zh: 天上那朵云，我飞得上去
lines.en: That cloud up there, I can reach it.
Hatch open, welcome aboard.
I've come to collect people, not to fight.
First, a check of the brakes.

lines.zh: 地上的影子是四个轮子
lines.en: My shadow on the ground has four wheels.
Nose to the east; there's a road that way.

lines.zh: 我和这世界不太搭，但能开
lines.en: I don't quite fit this world, but I roll.
Please fasten your seatbelt.
Flame warps my shell.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，底盘磕了
lines.en: I fell from height and my undercarriage struck.
Water flooded my engine and I stalled.

lines.zh: 炸得我翻了个身，轮子朝上
lines.en: The blast flipped me, wheels in the air.
An arrow sticks in my door like an ornament.

lines.zh: 符文爬上车壳，电路乱了
lines.en: Runes crawl my shell and my circuits scramble.
Energy running dry, the lights dim.

lines.zh: 雷打在车顶，整个电路一亮
lines.en: Lightning strikes my roof and the circuits flare.
I fall into the void with only wind left.
